info.title: Helm API
info.description:
Stable JSON API for the Helm project board and its built-in internal bug
tracker. Humans use a session cookie, Cloudflare Access identity, or the
private Tailnet edge identity; agents use scoped bearer tokens.
Single-resource responses contain the resource directly. Collections use
a cursor-paginated object containing data and next_cursor. Collection
cursors are opaque URL-safe keyset markers (retained decimal/base64
offsets remain accepted for compatibility) and an empty next_cursor means
that there is no next page. Every response includes X-Request-ID; deployments
that provide a release revision also include X-Roadmap-Revision.
Cookie-, Cloudflare-, and Tailnet-authenticated mutations require an Origin
that exactly matches the configured public origin; bearer-token mutations
do not require Origin. Temporary bearer-authentication or request-body
admission saturation returns 503 with Retry-After.
Mutation receipts are bound to the caller's effective authority; a changed
project/scope ceiling can return 409 idempotency_key_reused on retry.
The original operation may have committed; resolve it before using a new key.
